policies.text: Delta provides flight change and cancellation assistance through My Trips and the Fly Delta app. Refund or cancellation options depend on the ticket and disruption. A ticket bought through a third-party agency may require that agency's assistance. A public reply should not guarantee rebooking, compensation, or a refund without reviewing the booking.
policies.demo_reply: I'm sorry your travel was disrupted. Please check available options in My Trips or the Fly Delta app. Refund and change options depend on your ticket and circumstances. Keep your confirmation details private.

I'm sorry your bag is delayed. Please report it at Delta's Baggage Service Office and keep your file reference for tracking or a claim. Have you already filed a report? Please keep the reference private.
policies.text: For a delayed checked bag, Delta directs customers to report it at the airport baggage service office and retain the file reference for tracking or claims. Damaged and missing-item cases have separate reporting requirements. Any reimbursement depends on the case and applicable rules; a public tweet cannot establish eligibility or completed payment.
